decisions.interlude: credits x4 (3 bars each) over A character one-shot; music credit in outro
decisions.B_scene: verse1 second half (lines 6-10) as B mono manga: box text -> giant black glyphs
decisions.palette_check: allow mixes between the 4 colours + greys; flag anything else (glitch strips exempt)
decisions.reuse: key visual reused (intro, verse1 instrumental, pre); chorus layout reused (chorus1, last chorus)
decisions.character_framing: default camera = bust shot like the song cover (head to chest). Full-body character.png is only a source so crops never end awkwardly (e.g. pans/zoom-outs past the waist); bust.png (4096x4096) is the high-res source for close-ups and the outro face shot. Original line/colour untouched; silhouette/mono/grey are derived layers.
